scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ramon-itops/database && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @ramon-itops/api" "npm run dev -w @ramon-itops/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ramon-itops/database && npm run build -w @ramon-itops/api && npm run build -w @ramon-itops/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ramon-itops/database && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ramon-itops/database && npm run test -w @ramon-itops/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @ramon-itops/database && npm run test:integration -w @ramon-itops/api
